title: More with the Noise Complaints.
description: More with the Noise Complaints. — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Activate / Kill

Quest Description: Go to Balzack's Flame and shut down the party.

Quest Reward: Gold and 10 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Balzack's Flame and shut down the party.

Offer:

While you were away I got another noise complaint but this one was from the family that lives off of Rasputin's Holding Cell. They said that Balzack himself came through with his entourage and was blasting bad music, and throwing in-edible candy all over the place. What I need you to do is go down to Balzack's Flame, stop the party, and make Balzack understand he can not party so loud on a school night. Do you think you can do that Dungeon Runner?

When you are done with that come back to me The Townston Commander here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Well done Dungeon Runner. We just saw some monsters out putting up flyers for Balzack's next big party. You must have shut the last one down good enough to make them panic. I hope I get invited to .. I mean it would be wrong for us to go to a monster party in a dungeon. Keep running you Dungeon Runner.

Objectives:

  • Balzack
  • Turn off the Disco Lights ×4

Client level range: 57–100
